integrity: The embedded proof and checker give exact formulas for all sixty-four cells and an explicit boundary treatment; the status is a non-independent scientific review.
scientific_limitations: Only modulus five and consecutive triples are evaluated; comparison with unindexed earlier multipoint results is incomplete. The full mathematical conclusion follows from the supplied proof, while finite checks serve as reproducibility tests.
title: Forty-word triple spectrum of central trinomial residues modulo five
